The [repository README](../../README.md) is the entry point. General agent
instructions are in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md); reusable workflows live in
`.agents/skills/` at the repository root. The existing `doc/` directory holds
README images; application-specific documentation stays with its application.

Keep deployment credentials, databases, athlete data, backups and personal
operational notes outside this public source tree. Published tags retain their
original documentation paths; these locations apply to new revisions.
